# Altered gene expression linked to germline dysfunction following exposure to DEET

**Authors:** Nara Shin; Laura I Lascarez-Lagunas; Ayana L Henderson; Marina Martínez-García; Rajendiran Karthikraj; Victor Barrera; Shannan Ho Sui; Kurunthachalam Kannan; Mónica P Colaiácovo

## Main text

(iScience 27, 108699; January 19, 2024)

In the originally published version of this article, information about the model system Caenorhabditis elegans used in the study was not included in the title. With the permission of the authors, the editors at iScience have updated the title of this article to include the model organism used in this study. The editors apologize for any confusion this may have caused.
